description: This file defines data types, constants, enums, and inline functions related to Wi-Fi radio configurations, including MAC addresses, radio protocols, channel widths, radio types, scan types, queue types, report types, and RSSI sources. It serves as a type and constant definitions header for a Wi-Fi data pipeline module.

methods.name: timespec_to_timestamp
methods.description: Converts a timespec structure to a timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: get_timestamp
methods.description: Returns a monotonic timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: radio_get_chan_index
methods.description: Calculates the channel index based on radio type and channel number.

methods.name: radio_get_name_from_type
methods.description: Returns the string name for a given radio type.

methods.name: radio_get_name_from_cfg
methods.description: Generates a combined name from radio configuration.

methods.name: radio_get_type_from_name
methods.description: Returns radio type enum from a name string.

methods.name: radio_get_type_from_str
methods.description: Returns radio type enum from a string, using substring matching.

methods.name: radio_get_scan_name_from_type
methods.description: Returns scan type name string from enum.

methods.name: radio_get_scan_type_from_index
methods.description: Returns scan type enum from index.

methods.name: radio_get_index_from_type
methods.description: Returns index for a given radio type.

methods.name: radio_get_chan_from_mhz
methods.description: Calculates Wi-Fi channel number from frequency in MHz.

methods.name: radio_get_queue_name_from_type
methods.description: Returns queue name string from queue type enum.

methods.name: report_get_name_from_type
methods.description: Returns report type name string from enum.

methods.name: radio_get_scan_index_from_type
methods.description: Returns scan type enum from index.

methods.name: radio_get_index_from_type
methods.description: Returns index for a given radio type.
